sections.title: Contributors to population change in Allerdale
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Allerdale, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 6,031 people (−6.2%). In total, there were 7,266 births and 13,297 deaths in Allerdale between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 7,723 (8.0%). There were 35,948 people entering the area and 28,225 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Allerdale of 86 people (−0.1%), as a result of 2,224 people entering the area and 2,310 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Allerdale's population of 279 (0.3%).as a result of 1,765 people entering the area and 1,486 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
